Anastasya Zinger-Yaffe 
Hi Everyone, and a happy new week ☀️
I talked to the volunteers department of Mada TLV, and they gave me the basic requirements for the volunteers course:
1. you will need to supply an official confirmation you have at least 12 years of education (if you have a high-school, college or university diploma, that works).
2. you are older than 18.
3. you will need to supply an official confirmation from your country of origin, that you don't have any criminal or sex offenses.
4. regarding point 3, you will need to grant Mada permission to check with the Israeli police you don't have any criminal or sex offenses since your arrival to Israel.
5. we might be able to organize a course in English, but Mada will still need you to be able to communicate in Hebrew during your shifts. So basic speaking, reading and writing in Hebrew will be required.
6. you will need to commit to at least 2 shifts per month (a shift is 8 hours long).
7. confirmation of Hepatitis vaccine. 
If you meet all the listed conditions please PM me 🙏
